detail.title: 4MP 5x Smart Dual Light Pan & Tilt Network Camera
detail.overview: New Compare Favourite IPC-PT2449Z-Z5-A1S-PV 4MP 5x Smart Dual Light Pan & Tilt Network Camera Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 4 MP Resolution • 5x Optical Zoom • Built-in Dual Mic for Real-Time Audio Security • Auto Tracking Lite • 30%-50% Storage Saving with Super AI Coding • Smart Dual Light: Built-in IR and LED Lights with 3 Illumination Modes Supported • IP67 and IK10 Ratings for Protection Against Harsh Environments Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: 0.005 lux@F1.8 (Color, 30 IRE) 0.0005 lux@F1.8 (B/W, 30 IRE) 0 lux (illuminator on)
General.Illumination Distance: Up to 30 m (98.43 ft) (IR) Up to 30 m (98.43 ft) (Warm light)
General.DORI Distance: Lens Detect Observe Recognize Identify 2.7 mm–13.5 mm 210.0 m ( 688.98 ft) 83.0 m ( 272.31 ft) 42.0 m ( 137.80 ft) 21.0 m ( 68.90 ft) *DORI (Detect, Observe, Recognize, Identify) is a standard system (EN-62676-4) for defining the ability of a person viewing the video to distinguish persons or objects within a covered area. The numbers in this table do not reflect intelligent function distances. For intelligent function distances, refer to installation and commissioning manual/project design tool.
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Intrusion, tripwire (the two functions support the classification and accurate detection of vehicle and human)
General.Video Compression: H.265; H.264; H.264H; H.264B; MJPEG (Only supported by sub stream)
General.AI Coding: AI H.265; AI H.264 (Super AI Coding) *Includes smart codec technology, Smart H.265+ and Smart H.264+
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 2560 × 1440@(1–25/30 fps) Sub stream: 704 × 576@(1–25 fps)/704 × 480@(1–30 fps) Third stream: 352 × 288@1 fps/352 × 240@1 fps *The values above are the max frame rates of each stream; for multiple streams, the values will be subjected to the total encoding capacity.
General.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 32 kbps–6144 kbps H.265: 12 kbps–6144 kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; natural; street lamp; outdoor; manual; regional custom
General.Built-in Speaker: Yes, built-in speaker;Max power consumption: 2 W; max sound level at 10 cm: 110 dB * Test results from laboratory
General.Alarm Event: No SD card; SD card full; SD card error; network disconnection; IP conflict; illegal access; motion detection; video tampering; tripwire; intrusion; audio detection; voltage detection; SMD; security exception
General.Network Protocol: IPv4; IPv6; HTTP; TCP; UDP; ARP; RTP; RTSP; RTCP; RTMP; SMTP; FTP; SFTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; NTP; Multicast; ICMP; IGMP; NFS; P2P; Auto Registration
General.Interoperability: ONVIF (Profile S & Profile G & Profile T); CGI
General.Storage: FTP; SFTP; Micro SD card (supports max 512 GB)
General.Management Software: SmartPSS Lite; DSS; DMSS; DoLynk Care
General.Security: Digest;WSSE;Account lockout;Security logs;IP/MAC filtering;Generation and importing of X.509 certification;syslog;HTTPS;802.1x;Trusted boot;Trusted execution;Trusted upgrade;Session security;Security warning;SSL/TLS1.2;AES 256
General.Light Warning: Warm light warning Flash duration: 5 s–180 s Flash frequency: high, medium, low
General.Sound Warning: Offers 3 sound alarms and supports importing custom sound alarms. Sound: 0–100. Play times can be set from 1 to 10.
General.Certifications: CE-LVD: EN62368-1; CE-EMC: Electromagnetic Compatibility Directive 2014/30/EU
General.Dual Power Backup: When the power adapter and PoE provide power at the same time, disconnect one of them. The device will continue to work, but will not restart.
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 2.10 W (12 VDC); 2.87 W (PoE) Max (PT rotation + illuminator intensity): 11.65 W (12 VDC); 12.95 W (PoE)
General.Protection: IP66; IK10; TVS 4000V lightning proof; surge protection; voltage transient protection
General.Anti-corrosion Level: Basic Protection *The products are designed for general use and are applicable even in areas with no specific requirements for anti-corrosion protection.
